name: Home gauge CSS
format:
<style>
  @import url("https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/orioncactus/pretendard@v1.3.8/dist/web/static/pretendard.css");

  body.nr-dashboard-theme {
    background-color: #050d19 !important;
    font-family: "Pretendard", sans-serif !important;
  }

  .md-card {
    background-color: #0a1624 !important;
    border-radius: 20px !important;
    border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05) !important;
    box-shadow: none !important;
    padding: 16px 18px !important;
  }

  .nr-dashboard-gauge .label-min,
  .nr-dashboard-gauge .label-max,
  .nr-dashboard-gauge text.min,
  .nr-dashboard-gauge text.max {
    display: none !important;
    opacity: 0 !important;
    visibility: hidden !important;
  }

  .nr-dashboard-gauge text {
    fill: #e2e8f0 !important;
    font-weight: 600 !important;
    font-size: 26px !important;
    transform: translateY(-5px);
  }

  .nr-dashboard-cardtitle {
    color: #94a3b8 !important;
    font-size: 14px !important;
    font-weight: 500 !important;
    text-align: center !important;
    margin-bottom: 8px !important;
  }

  .nr-dashboard-gauge .label-small {
    display: none !important;
  }

  .nr-dashboard-gauge path.back-theme {
    opacity: 0.15 !important;
    stroke-width: 10px !important;
  }

  .nr-dashboard-gauge path.fg-arc {
    stroke-width: 10px !important;
    stroke-linecap: round !important;
  }

  .away-card {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 16px;
    padding: 0;
    border-radius: inherit;
    background: transparent !important;
    box-shadow: none !important;
    color: #e5e7eb;
    width: 100%;
    box-sizing: border-box;
  }

  .away-card-icon {
    font-size: 32px;
    min-width: 52px;
    min-height: 52px;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    border-radius: 16px;
    background: rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.9);
  }

  .away-card-body {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 4px;
  }

  .away-card-title {
    font-size: 13px;
    color: #9ca3af;
  }

  .away-card-main {
    font-size: 18px;
    font-weight: 700;
  }

  .away-card-sub {
    font-size: 13px;
    color: #d1d5db;
  }

  .away-card-meta {
    font-size: 11px;
    color: #6b7280;
    margin-top: 4px;
  }

  .md-card.away-card {
    background: transparent !important;
    border: none !important;
    padding: 0 !important;
    box-shadow: none !important;
  }

  div.away-card.outfit-card {
    position: relative;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 16px;
    padding: 18px 22px;
    padding-right: 42px;
    border-radius: 20px;
    background: radial-gradient(circle at 0% 0%, rgba(248, 113, 22, 0.18), rgba(15, 23, 42, 1));
    border: 1px solid rgba(248, 113, 22, 0.5);
    box-shadow: 0 14px 35px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.7), 0 0 18px rgba(248, 113, 22, 0.35);
    color: #e5e7eb;
    min-height: 140px;
  }

  div.away-card.outfit-card::after {
    content: "";
    position: absolute;
    right: 16px;
    top: 14px;
    bottom: 14px;
    width: 4px;
    border-radius: 999px;
    background: linear-gradient(to bottom, #fed7aa, #fb923c, #f97316);
    box-shadow: 0 0 12px rgba(248, 153, 72, 0.8);
  }

  div.away-card.outfit-card .away-card-icon {
    background: radial-gradient(circle at 30% 20%, #60a5fa, #1d4ed8 60%, #020617 100%);
    box-shadow: 0 10px 25px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.8);
  }

  div.away-card.outfit-card .away-card-title {
    font-size: 16px !important;
  }

  div.away-card.outfit-card .away-card-main {
    font-size: 28px !important;
    font-weight: 800;
    color: #f97316;
  }

  div.away-card.outfit-card .away-card-sub {
    font-size: 16px !important;
    color: #e5e7eb;
  }

  div.away-card.outfit-card .away-card-meta {
    font-size: 13px !important;
  }

  div.away-card.umbrella-card {
    position: relative;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 16px;
    padding: 18px 22px;
    padding-right: 42px;
    border-radius: 20px;
    background: radial-gradient(circle at 0% 0%, rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.2), rgba(15, 23, 42, 1));
    border: 1px solid rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.6);
    box-shadow: 0 14px 35px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.7), 0 0 18px rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.35);
    color: #e5e7eb;
    min-height: 140px;
  }

  div.away-card.umbrella-card::after {
    content: "";
    position: absolute;
    right: 16px;
    top: 14px;
    bottom: 14px;
    width: 4px;
    border-radius: 999px;
    background: linear-gradient(to bottom, #e0f2fe, #38bdf8, #0ea5e9);
    box-shadow: 0 0 12px rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.8);
  }

  div.away-card.umbrella-card .away-card-icon {
    background: radial-gradient(circle at 30% 20%, #e0f2fe, #38bdf8 60%, #020617 100%);
    box-shadow: 0 10px 25px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.8);
  }

  div.away-card.umbrella-card .away-card-title {
    font-size: 16px !important;
  }

  div.away-card.umbrella-card .away-card-main {
    font-size: 26px !important;
    font-weight: 800;
  }

  div.away-card.umbrella-card .away-card-sub {
    font-size: 16px !important;
  }

  div.away-card.umbrella-card .away-card-meta {
    font-size: 13px !important;
  }

  .away-events-card {
    margin-top: 8px;
    background: #020617;
    padding: 16px 18px;
    border-radius: 18px;
    box-shadow: 0 16px 30px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.45);
    color: #e5e7eb;
  }

  .away-events-card .header {
    display: flex;
    justify-content: space-between;
    align-items: baseline;
    margin-bottom: 10px;
  }

  .away-events-card .title {
    font-size: 16px;
    font-weight: 700;
  }

  .away-events-card .subtitle {
    font-size: 12px;
    color: #64748b;
  }

  .away-events-card .list {
    position: relative;
    padding-left: 20px;
    border-left: 2px solid #1f2937;
    margin-left: 4px;
  }

  .away-events-card .row {
    position: relative;
    padding-left: 10px;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 8px;
  }

  .away-events-card .row::before {
    content: "";
    position: absolute;
    left: -11px;
    top: 50%;
    transform: translateY(-50%);
    width: 9px;
    height: 9px;
    border-radius: 999px;
    background: #38bdf8;
    box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.2);
  }

  .away-events-card .row.intrusion::before {
    background: #ef4444;
    box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(248, 113, 113, 0.25);
  }

  .away-events-card .row.sound::before {
    background: #22c55e;
    box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(34, 197, 94, 0.25);
  }

  .away-events-card .time {
    width: 54px;
    font-size: 12px;
    color: #9ca3af;
  }

  .away-events-card .badge {
    font-size: 12px;
    padding: 4px 10px;
    border-radius: 999px;
    background: #020617;
    color: #e5e7eb;
    border: 1px solid #1f2937;
    box-shadow: 0 4px 10px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.35);
  }

  .away-events-card .badge.intrusion {
    background: #b91c1c;
    border-color: #f97373;
    color: #fee2e2;
  }

  .away-events-card .badge.sound {
    background: #1d4ed8;
    border-color: #60a5fa;
    color: #dbeafe;
  }

  .away-events-card .empty {
    font-size: 13px;
    color: #6b7280;
    margin-top: 6px;
  }
</style>
